title: Dock, prove and cycle a DN100 split valve before powder transfer
instruction: Dock and mechanically prove the DN100 powder-transfer split-valve fixture. Align the supported 8 kg upper assembly at X=Y=0, interface height Z=1.000 m, with both discs closed. Turn the retaining collar to 30 degrees, pass the two-second 100 N net separation proof, then turn proof off. Open the active disc to 90 degrees so actual drive-dog contact opens the passive disc too. Close both discs, return the collar to zero and raise the upper half to Z=1.100 m. Leave both detached discs seated closed. Do not open an undocked or unlocked half. This is a mechanical readiness test; it does not certify containment.
context: Split valves must lock, operate as a coupled pair and independently reseat before container separation. This full-size dry commissioning fixture tests those mechanical operations for battery-ingredient equipment, not filled-vessel handling or containment.
setup: SI coordinates, Z up. Custom floor-anchored steel rig: 100 kg fixed frame, two 60x60x1650 mm posts at X=+/-250,Y=150 mm, 200x240x40 mm feet and 600x100x80 mm upper crossbeam at Z=1650 mm. The lower bracket is 220x320x40 mm at (0,100,900) mm, supported by a 60x300x900 mm column. Two 2 kg XY carriages carry the upper assembly on an ideal native vertical guide. Lower interface centre is (0,0,1000) mm. Upper initially X=8,Y=-6,Z=1100 mm; collar and both discs start at zero degrees. Upper payload is 8 kg: 7.500 kg housing/vessel, 0.300 kg passive rotor and eight 25 g seat units. The empty upper steel sleeve is ID170/OD180x200 mm, centred 216 mm above its interface; neck ID104/OD120x100 mm, centre 66 mm above. Upper casing ID112/OD120x16 mm, centre 8 mm above interface; fixed casing ID112/OD160x16 mm, centre 8 mm below. Lower neck ID104/OD120x80 mm, centre 60 mm below. All annular machine housings use 48 convex sectors. Each half has a solid 32-sided steel disc, diameter100x2 mm, faces meeting at the interface. Only the lower rotor is motorized. Each rotor assembly is 0.300 kg including stub and external 60x12x12 mm steel drive dog at Y=-135 mm. Lower dog centre Z=-6 mm, upper +6 mm relative to their interface; flat faces touch when docked and disengage on lifting. This is custom coupling geometry, not OEM internals. Three upper lugs, 24x8x6 mm at radius70 mm and 0/120/240 degrees, have centre Z=+13 mm. A 1 kg retaining collar has ID200/OD220x20 mm rim at Z=+9 mm; ID166/OD210x10 mm bridge at +27.1 mm; three 100-degree ledges at radius65..85 mm, height6 mm, centre +19.1 mm, leave 20-degree entry slots. Closed docked lug/ledge clearance is 0.1 mm. The collar rotates 0..32 degrees and carries a 160x16x12 mm lever. Two 4 mm rotor interlock pins at (40,125,2) and (0,125,40) mm meet a 60x18x6 mm collar block at (40,125,-3.1) mm. Native contacts inhibit opening while unlocked and unlocking while open. Eight shoe units per half are centred every45 degrees from22.5 degrees, radius50.9 mm, at disc midplanes. Each comprises 3 g radial guide, 2 g tangential guide and 20 g shoe. Four-sector polymer lip shoes are ID99.6/OD104x2 mm. Radial travel -1..+3 mm, stiffness10 kN/m, damping32 Ns/m, cap30 N; axial +/-8 mm and tangential +/-2 mm, both1 kN/m and9 Ns/m, caps10 N and5 N. These are reduced custom compliant-seat parameters requiring calibration. XY drives: 1 kN,1.5 MN/m,10 kNs/m,20 mm/s. Z: force-limited1 kN,100 kN/m,1 kNs/m,25 mm/s with payload gravity compensation; proof removes all Z position/damping feedback and applies weight plus100 N upward. Collar drive5 Nm,120 Nm/rad,2 Nms/rad,20 deg/s. Active drive10 Nm, 600 Nm/rad,2 Nms/rad,30 deg/s. Passive spring0.5 Nm/rad,0.1 Nms/rad,0.8 Nm cap, fixed rest -0.6 rad gives0.3 Nm closing preload; it is never policy-controlled. Six encoders, sixteen own-disc radial contact gauges and actual collar/proof force readings accompany two cameras. Overview (0.8,-1,1.55) m points at (0,0,0.95),20 mm focal length; detail (0,-0.065,1.60) points at (0,0,1.0),55 mm focal length; both1280x720. Exact collision shapes, brackets, stroke limits and material coefficients are in the supplied original generator and machine.usda. No powder is present.
scoring: Latched zero for nonfinite/workspace failure, actual opening over2 degrees while undocked (XY error>0.5 mm or Z error>0.5 mm) or collar below10 degrees, or docked coupling mismatch over2 degrees while collar>=10 degrees. 0.25 for stationary docked halves, both discs within2 degrees closed and all 16 own-disc radial gauges>=0.5 N. 0.5 for collar27..32 degrees and actual net100+/-1 N proof held2 s with downward collar contact>=80 N; a preceding1 s encoder window and loaded baseline excursion must stay within0.1 mm/axis and0.5 degree. Lost retention during requested proof erases its history. Full score additionally requires proof off (actual net<1 N), both discs opened>=88 degrees with mismatch<=2 degrees while docked/locked, then both closed<=2 degrees with all16 gauges>=0.5 N before separation. Finish at upper Z>=1.095 m, collar<=2 degrees, both detached discs closed and all16 gauges>=0.5 N for a stationary1 s window, proof off. All other outcomes score0; task_score is computed from actual native readouts.
run_limit: 30 LLM calls, at most 1,600 control actions at 20 Hz (80 simulation seconds); at most 400 actions per response.
reset_notes: Seed0, reload the fixed scene, restore actual joints/seat springs, disable proof and clear all scorer and policy history. Trial output directories must be fresh.
fidelity: Original full-size dry DN100/8 kg custom fixture; not an OEM digital twin. Native contact dogs, lug retention and force-only100 N proof; passive disc never commanded. Three-axis spring shoes approximate elastomer lips. 32-sided discs,48-sector housings; CPU TGS960 Hz,64/1 iterations. Ideal bearings/guides and benchmark actuator/spring choices require calibration. No powder, leakage, wear, chemistry or containment certification. Numerical contact integrity needs native validation.
scores: Pending current-source full-score native demo and genuine LLM evaluation; no submission-ready scores claimed.
